rent.note: furnished 1BR (3 1/2) on the Plateau, 31-night-minimum monthly lease ~CAD 2,200 at 1.424 CAD/USD (listing at CAD 2,150 incl. electricity and heat). City-wide unfurnished 1BR asking rent CAD 1,743 (rentals.ca, Sep 2026 report)

utilities.note: ~CAD 130: home internet + Hydro-Québec electricity; many furnished monthly lets include heat/electricity, so this is a buffer. Could not open a Hydro-Québec tariff figure or an ISP price page

groceries.note: derived: family-of-four food spend CAD 17,571.79/yr = ~CAD 366 per person/mo; +15% for a single household and Quebec's above-average inflation -> ~CAD 420

diningOut.note: ~CAD 430: about a dozen casual meals out with tax and tip plus cafés; aggregator dinner price $18

transit.note: STM/ARTM Monthly All Modes A (métro, bus, REM, exo in Zone A) CAD 110, fare schedule effective 2026-07-01; BIXI bike-share is an optional summer extra

coworking.note: Plateau hot desks ~CAD 199-275/mo (Halte 24-7 from CAD 199, ECTO ~250, Montreal Cowork ~255) as compiled by a competing operator; used CAD 275

misc.note: gym, toiletries, festival tickets, entertainment, buffer

accomSeasonality._doc: Editorial: furnished short-let demand peaks with the June-August festival summer (and the July 1 moving-day churn); winter months are the cheapest to book.
